documents.title: Noting In The Board Meeting Dated 29.10.2026 Delay In Submission Of Shareholding Pattern Under Reg 31(1)(B) To NSE.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings reported strong consolidated financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27, with total income, EBITDA, and PAT showing significant growth over the previous year. Management stated that they expect annual revenue growth of more than 30% for FY27 and FY28, driven by domestic demand, rapidly growing US exports, and newly developed business pipelines in Europe. To support this growth and mitigate labor constraints, the company is actively pursuing automation and robotic cells while maintaining robust EBITDA margins. Menon Bearings reported a strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, with consolidated revenue from operations increasing by 58.6% year-on-year to Rs. 100.9 crore for Q2 FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue growth of more than 30% for the financial year FY27.
guidance.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

guidance.claim: Management targets an EBITDA margin of about 23% for the next year.
guidance.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

guidance.claim: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical stability.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: For the Alkop division, the company targets INR100 crores for this year and around INR125 crores for next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: In the brakes segment, the management expects an initial business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores in the first year after validation, growing up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within the next two years.
guidance.quote: and with this in the first year itself, we expect that to start with, we will have a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores to start with and eventually it will go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.

guidance.claim: The share of electric vehicles in the Alkop business is targeted to reach 8% to 10% in the near future over the next two years.
guidance.quote: So we are also targeting, so 8% is for the near future, for the next two years.

guidance.claim: The company's full-year revenue guidance of INR360 crores is described by management as a conservative figure.
guidance.quote: And we have told INR360 crore is a conservative number.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that US exports are growing rapidly.
demand_outlook.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

demand_outlook.claim: European tour business potential is expected to convert into actual sales in FY27-28 and FY28-29.
demand_outlook.quote: Along with that, our recently Europe tour is yielding a significant increase in the business and potential of more than INR 35 crores that will be converted into the actual sale in the year '27-'28 and '28-'29.

demand_outlook.claim: Additional business expected for 2026-27 is around INR 30 crores on a consolidated basis.
demand_outlook.quote: And what I feel, that considering the current business pipeline and the commercial discussions and RFQs that we have received, for '26-'27, additional business expected is around INR 30 crores on consolidated basis.

demand_outlook.claim: Estimated additional business for 2027-28 is expected to be INR 131 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: And for '27-'28, we expect that estimated additional business will be of INR 131 crores, so that, the growth rate will be obviously more than 30%, with '28-'29, the growth driver, we are having the list of all customers also from whom we are estimated to get the business, RFQs are there, and discussions are going on, commercials have been finalized.

demand_outlook.claim: The underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Visits to Canada and the USA are expected to yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: That is because, more particularly, due to our last month's visit to Canada and USA, is expected to yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.

capex_expansion.claim: Planned investment for the next 12 months is approximately INR 5 crores in Menon Alkop and INR 4 crores in bearings.
capex_expansion.quote: So what figures we have told you, what we are going to achieve. So this is the investment we are doing to increase productivity and to get these numbers. So this is the investment we are getting, and roughly ROI will be in the next 2.5, 3 years, should be the return on investment on this investment what we are doing.

capex_expansion.claim: The dynamometer for the brake segment is under construction and expected to be commissioned by the end of August.
capex_expansion.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has incurred capital expenditure of around INR4 crores for the Alkop division alone for the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins are expected to range between 20% to 22%.
margins_costs.quote: So this is the process. It will range between 20% to 22%, always there.

margins_costs.claim: Segment-wise margins are 30% to 35% for Brakes, 18% to 19% for Alkop, and 23% for Bearings.
margins_costs.quote: Okay, so far as Brakes is concerned, the margins are 30% to 35%. It depends upon the mix of the product, but it is between 30% to 35%, okay, that is one thing. In Alkop, it is 18% to 19%, whereas in Bearing, it is 23%, okay?

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 22.00%.
PAT margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 14.60%.
Standalone bi-metal sales increased 40.41% year-on-year, while EBITDA increased by approximately 60%.
margins_costs.quote: during the quarter sales increased to INR67.06 crores from INR47.76 crores as compared to the corresponding quarter of the last year that is year-on-year increase of 40.41% and further increased by about 41%. EBITDA is up by ~60%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for the quarter was up by 57%.
margins_costs.quote: And EBITDA on a consolidated basis is up by 57%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin in the brakes segment reached 25% during the quarter, up from earlier levels of 12% to 14%.
margins_costs.quote: But at the same time, I would like to tell you that right from 12% EBITDA earlier, now we have reached to 25% EBITDA in brakes also.

margins_costs.claim: Segment-wise EBITDA margins are around 21% plus for bi-metal, approximately 21% for Alkop, and 25% for brakes for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So, for the bi-metal is concerned the margin, so, EBITDA margins are around 21% plus. Then Alkop, it is almost 21%. And now, for this quarter, in brakes, we have achieved 25%.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for brake lines is 30 lakh units per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity 30 lakh units/annum for Brake Lines

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at Menon Bearings stands at around 80% to 87%.
orders_capacity.quote: looking at the 87%, actually, which is the capacity utilization at Menon Bearing.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx for bi-metal and Alkop will be funded entirely through internal accruals with no fresh loans taken.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders to African markets were stuck over the prior three months due to backlogs caused by the Strait of Hormuz situation and war.
risks_headwinds.quote: last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

risks_headwinds.claim: In the tractor segment, weather conditions such as a drought-like situation in some parts could affect performance to some extent.
risks_headwinds.quote: considering the monsoon position that may -- in tractor segment affect today to some extent, not larger, because in some parts there is a drought-like situation

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that automation and visual inspection systems are expected to be put in place over the next 9 to 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: So in the next 9 to 12 months, a lot of automation and visual systems are getting in place where we save on manpower, we save on time that leads in productivity, and quality is more focused.

management_commitments.claim: Five robotic automation initiatives are rolling out between November 2026 and April 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Five initiatives rolling out Nov 2026 – Apr 2027 to lift productivity, quality and machine utilization

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the dynamometer in the brake segment to be commissioned by the end of August.
management_commitments.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

management_commitments.claim: The technical testing rig team expects the setup to be fully running by September end.
management_commitments.quote: So by September end, it should be all running.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to visit European customers and markets over a 15-day period in September.
management_commitments.quote: So in September, we have a visit to Europe also, we are there for 15 days.

management_commitments.claim: The share of electric vehicles in the Alkop business is targeted to reach 8% in the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: So we are also targeting, so 8% is for the near future, for the next two years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
